messages:
auditor_claire: Hi, auditor here. For SOC 2 fieldwork please provide evidence for the recent RBAC cleanup (PR #8021) and the KMS rotation on 2026-03-22. Deliverables requested: role diff + approver trail, auth logs for +/-48h around the change (90d history optional), KMS rotation manifest & DescribeKey outputs, sample object list with ETag and encryption-context, a test proving old key cannot decrypt new ciphertexts, vuln triage link and short timeline.

nina_sec: Nina from Security. We can assemble this. Preferred audit window? 90d or 48h around the rollout? We will GPG-sign the manifest and include sha256 checksums.

auditor_claire: 90d preferred but 48h + full change history for the service account and approver trail is acceptable. Checksums required.

tom_ops: Ops here. I will export CloudTrail and auth-proxy logs to a presigned S3 path: https://s3-presigned.redwood/evidence/1712345679/auth-48h.jsonl.gz (valid 7d). Sample log line: `{\"time\":\"2026-03-22T01:12:33Z\",\"actor\":\"deploy-bot\",\"action\":\"rbac.update\",\"target\":\"svc-inference\",\"req\":\"req-ff12\"}`

nina_sec: KMS rotation executed 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z. We will attach rotation-manifest-2026-03-22.json (sha256: e3b0c...), DescribeKey outputs for old/new keys, and the CloudTrail KMS event bundle.

tom_ops: We will include a sampling manifest with 10 objects: object key, S3 ETag, encryption-context (e.g., service=inference, rotation=2026-03-22). Also will include a decrypt-failure script.

nina_sec: Example commands we will document in README: `aws s3api list-objects --bucket redwood-inference --prefix inference/ | jq .` and
```
# attempt decrypt with OLD key (expected fail)
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://sample.enc --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/old-key-arn || echo \"decrypt failed as expected\"
```

auditor_claire: Also need approver identities and approval timestamps, plus a statement that no emergency hotpatches or manual credential resets were performed. Include GPG signature and md5/sha256 for each uploaded file.

nina_sec: Approvers: @alex (2026-03-21T18:05:12Z), @nina_sec (2026-03-21T18:12:45Z). No emergency workarounds were used, standard canary rollout only. We will add chain-of-custody and a signed statement.

sysbot: presigned URLs created: https://s3-presigned.redwood/evidence/1712345679/auth-48h.jsonl.gz, https://s3-presigned.redwood/evidence/1712345679/kms-rotation.json (valid 7 days).

tom_ops: Vulnerability triage: CVE-2026-1010 affected a third-party library; patched and redeployed 2026-03-20, before RBAC change. Triage doc: https://go.redwood/triage/CVE-2026-1010. Will include short timeline in manifest.

auditor_claire: Please email the signed bundle to auditor.soc2@redwood.com once uploaded and include verification steps so an auditor can run the decrypt-failure test.

nina_sec: ETA 48 hours for signed bundle + README + checksums. I will DM presigned links when uploads complete.

auditor_claire: Thanks, appreciate it. :thumbsup:
